slides.sub: Which one did your buyer see?
slides.alt: One steel valve with three glowing price tags, each reached for by a different buyer.

slides.headline: Monday, 9:12 am. The distributor.
slides.body: Contract tier. Net 30. He expects the price he negotiated in March.
slides.alt: Distributor in a warehouse holding a contract binder and a phone.

slides.headline: Tuesday, 9:15 pm. A new buyer.
slides.body: No account yet. List price. She is comparing three tabs and one deadline.
slides.alt: Buyer at a night laptop with three browser tabs open and rain on the window.

slides.headline: Friday, 4:50 pm. The big account.
slides.body: A volume break starts at the next step. Nobody remembers which line.
slides.alt: Pallets beside a glowing staircase of price steps for volume breaks.

slides.headline: A guessed price always costs.
slides.body: Guess high and the buyer leaves. Guess low and the margin does.
slides.alt: Rep guessing a price over a spreadsheet while a buyer walks out of the door.

slides.headline: Price should follow the buyer.
slides.body: I answer from the pricing of the customer group a buyer belongs to.
slides.alt: Laptop showing one product with a single glowing price and a customer group badge.
